svg.title: One local section at each Datum CSYS / 各データム座標系に局所断面を作成
svg.desc: Four coordinate systems around a rounded seal path. At each position Z follows the local path tangent, and the indicated XY section is perpendicular to it. Timestamp order determines grid order.

g.text: CSYS positions define the sampling stations / 座標系の位置が断面位置を決定
SCHEMATIC PLAN / 平面模式図 · Section plane = CSYS XY / 断面はCSYSのXY平面
Local XY cuts / 各点のXY断面
Ascending timestamp, not CSYS name or spatial position / 座標系名や空間位置ではなくタイムスタンプ昇順
